# Requirements Quality Checklist: Agent Multisession

**Purpose**: Check the quality of the entire multisession requirements, with a focus on TDD,
restart and consistent responsibility boundaries; no implementation check.
**Created**: 2026-10-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Depth**: Standard
**Audience / Timing**: Reviewer before `/speckit.tasks`
**Selected Focus**: Q1=A, Q2=A

**Note**: This custom checklist was generated by `/speckit.checklist`.
**Review Ownership**: The assessment belongs to the reviewer. Newly generated items remain `[ ]`.
An agent may help with the assessment only after an explicit assessment instruction.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means approved requirement quality, not completed
implementation, passed product tests or demonstrated TDD execution.

**Reference Documents**: [Plan](../plan.md), [Data model](../data-model.md),
[public contract](../contracts/public-api.md),
[provider contract](../contracts/provider-contract.md),
[validation guide](../quickstart.md),
[Constitution](../../../.specify/memory/constitution.md).

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the scope described exclusively as multisession management, and are own agent loops, tool execution, context compaction and context reconstruction explicitly excluded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024–FR-025, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK002 Are the responsibilities of library, consuming host and provider completely delimited, including access control, configuration and session functions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-026–FR-027]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements for opening, follow-up request, status, closing and local deletion of a session, including their respective prerequisites, documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-021, Public Contract §2]
- [x] CHK004 Do the requirements distinguish durably confirmed acceptance, reservation, possible external acceptance and saved completion, including their respective responsibility boundaries? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-018–FR-020, Data Model §State Transitions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Are local session identifier, native session reference, individual external operation identifier and changing continuation state conceptually clearly separated from each other? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities, Data Model §Session, Provider Contract §2]
- [x] CHK006 Is the meaning of acceptance order for simultaneously arriving requests unambiguously defined, without equating caller order, timestamps and confirmed order? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Public Contract §3]
- [x] CHK007 Are cancellation request, local request end and confirmed external termination explicitly distinguished, in particular for a cancellation during admission? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Public Contract §3–4]
- [x] CHK008 Are the start and scope of waiting, request and shutdown deadlines as well as the resulting states unambiguously described? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-013, Spec §SC-004, Public Contract §5]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Is the requirement to reject unsupported capabilities before an execution compatible with the later forwarding of provider-side function errors, without presupposing an excluded complete feature catalog? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK010 Do the requirements for closing a session with uncertain work agree with the prerequisites for reservation release and finally closed states? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-020–FR-021, Data Model §RecoveryDecision, Data Model §State Transitions]
- [x] CHK011 Is the difference between explicitly ended waiting requests at a controlled stop and waiting requests to be resumed after a crash described without contradiction? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-018, Plan §Project Structure, Public Contract §1]
- [x] CHK012 Is the promise of independent continued work compatible with capacity still occupied by uncertain requests, including the case of fully reserved capacity? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-020, Plan §Project Structure]

## TDD Requirement Quality

- [x] CHK013 Do the development rules require, for every new or changed behavior requirement, first an observed functional Red proof, then minimal Green and subsequently behavior-preserving refactoring? [Completeness, Constitution §IV, Plan §TDD Implementation Strategy]
- [x] CHK014 Do the rules define unambiguously why compiler errors, missing prerequisites, undiscovered tests and missing accesses do not constitute functional Red evidence? [Clarity, Constitution §IV, Quickstart §Test-First Cycle Before Every Behavior Implementation]
- [x] CHK015 Is the delimitation between behavior change, pure refactoring and documentation/build metadata change unambiguous enough not to silently widen TDD exceptions? [Clarity, Constitution §IV, Plan §TDD Implementation Strategy]
- [x] CHK016 Is a previously failing regression test explicitly required for bug fixes and a previously green relevant suite for pure refactorings? [Completeness, Constitution §IV, Plan §TDD Implementation Strategy]
- [x] CHK017 Are the TDD units traceably mapped to the requirements and success criteria, and do they explicitly include persistence, recovery, data protection, provider boundaries and consuming hosts? [Traceability, Plan §TDD Implementation Strategy, Spec §FR-001–FR-027, Spec §SC-001–SC-011]
- [x] CHK018 Is it defined which information must prove the chronological Red–Green order and why later green acceptances or fakes do not replace earlier Red or real vendor evidence? [Measurability, Constitution §IV, Plan §Q-06, Quickstart §8]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK019 Are the start of measurement, prerequisites and expected observation for the two-second cancellation and ten-second shutdown, including the restriction to cooperative connections, defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK020 Are the initial state, session assignment of waiting requests and expected states after each restart unambiguously described in the restart criterion? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009, Spec §User Story 5]
- [x] CHK021 Are load, duration, the notion of loss and the target system reference of the parallelism, assignment, capacity and continuous operation criteria specified precisely enough that different reviewers understand the same guarantee? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-003, Spec §SC-005, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK022 Is it objectively delimited which embeddability the consuming proof demonstrates and which actual SharpClaw migration is explicitly not yet guaranteed? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-027, Spec §SC-011, Spec §Assumptions]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK023 Do the requirements cover both separate native session opening and provider bindings that only come into being with the first message, including an uncertain first job? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-020, Provider Contract §2–4]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements for invalid configuration, missing authorization, provider outage, expired native session and context limit each described without permitting a silent substitute path? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-011–FR-012, Spec §FR-025, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 Are normal admission, overload rejection and sessions blocked for longer described as different scenarios, and are any waiting-time/fairness guarantees explicitly defined or excluded? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-007–FR-008, Plan §Project Structure]
- [x] CHK026 Are controlled termination, unexpected host abort and explicitly triggered recovery each described with their different continuation rules? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §User Story 5, Public Contract §1, Public Contract §4]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK027 Is it defined how an already durably accepted request remains findable when the acceptance confirmation is lost and which limits apply to resubmission or deduplication? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK028 Are the cases of possible external effect without a saved operation identifier as well as of an existing response without saved completion/continuation state explicitly taken into account? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018–FR-020, Data Model §Storage and Transaction Boundaries, Provider Contract §5]
- [x] CHK029 Are prerequisites and conflict rules for a recovery decision described, including stale decisions and the separation of termination confirmation and proof of success? [Coverage, Public Contract §4, Data Model §RecoveryDecision]
- [x] CHK030 Are requirements for retention and deletion with waiting, running or unresolved jobs defined, and are local deletion, external provider data and backups clearly separated? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §Restart and Retention]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK031 Is the shared trust domain per instance, including host-side access obligations and explicitly non-guaranteed isolation against malicious code, unambiguously described? [Security, Spec §FR-026, Spec §Assumptions, Public Contract §5]
- [x] CHK032 Are confidentiality requirements for stored contents, credentials, error messages and diagnostics compatible with the requirements for observable history and retention? [Privacy, Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-021, Constitution §V]
- [x] CHK033 Is the required equality of functional guarantees on Windows and Linux delimited from the limits of the guaranteed platform scope and non-replaceable target system evidence? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-023, Spec §SC-007, Plan §Target Platform]
- [x] CHK034 For bounded input/output sizes and queues, are rejection, incomplete results and effects on unchanged history data explicitly described in addition to the limits? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-025, Public Contract §5, Data Model §RequestResult and HistoryEntry]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK035 Are dependencies on native session storage and model/provider-related limits documented without deriving from local history a recoverability of externally expired sessions? [Dependency, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-025, Spec §Assumptions, Provider Contract §3–4]
- [x] CHK036 Is the long-term embedding in SharpClaw described consistently with the independence of the library and the explicitly separate existing-state/product migration? [Assumption, Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-027, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK037 Are governance prerequisites such as the ratification date and the approved Codemetr tool version/default thresholds without a debt baseline documented with responsibility or required decision and blocking effect? [Dependency, Gap, Constitution 2.0.0 §Sync Impact Report (removed in 2.1.0), Constitution §III, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK038 Are missing provider accesses or target systems treated as pending additional acceptances, without them supplying functional Red evidence or being allowed to count as fulfilled through simulated results? [Dependency, Consistency, Constitution §IV, Plan §TDD Implementation Strategy, Quickstart §6]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK039 Are request state, execution certainty, session lifecycle and block reason used conceptually consistently, and are permissible combinations such as a local end with uncertain external effect described without contradiction? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009–FR-010, Data Model §Session, Data Model §Request, Data Model §State Transitions]
- [x] CHK040 Is it unambiguously defined whether errors during a change of the stored format, including restart/return to the previous state, belong to the current scope or are explicitly specified later? [Gap, Spec §FR-018–FR-021, Data Model §StoreMetadata, Constitution §Technical constraints]

## Notes

- At creation, all 40 items were deliberately unassessed. The user explicitly commissioned the
  assessment and remediation on 2026-10-27; for the result see the review below.
- This checklist checks completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability and coverage
  of the documents; it contains no product test cases and no instruction to implement.
- `[Gap]`, `[Ambiguity]` and `[Conflict]` mark review questions, not new approved
  product requirements. The reviewer adds answers and references after the assessment.
- Section references denote the headings and stable FR/SC identifiers of the
  linked documents. `Plan §Q-06` denotes the TDD release gate within the TDD strategy.
- `/speckit.implement` reads the state of the checklist as a gate and MUST NOT change markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle through
  `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify` and was not changed here.
- No application code, test run or Red/Green evidence is claimed with this checklist.

## Review 2026-10-27

**Assignment**: Explicit user approval „ja bitte bewerten und lösen“ ("yes please assess and resolve").
**Method**: AI-assisted document review against the named sources, followed by a renewed
assessment of the corrected requirements. No product, provider or runtime tests.
**Result**: At the initial assessment, 27 criteria fulfilled and 13 with a documentation finding;
after correction 40/40 fulfilled, no requirement quality criterion open anymore.
The 40 previously unassessed markers were only set in the explicitly commissioned review.

### Resolved Findings

| Item | Finding before correction | Resolution and evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CHK008 | Local admission deadline, queue waiting time and execution deadline were not sufficiently separated | Public Contract §3/§5: AdmissionTimeout five seconds from submit receipt; no automatic queue waiting deadline; request deadline only from dispatch; stop deadline from stop receipt. Data Model §Restart and Retention and the plan are aligned. |
| CHK009 | “Reject an unsupported capability before execution” could require an excluded complete feature catalog | Spec §Edge Cases and Provider Contract §1 distinguish locally known configuration errors from limits only detectable at the provider. |
| CHK010 | The effect of a recovery close on lifecycle and uncertain reservations was only indirectly described | FR-020, Data Model §RecoveryDecision and Public Contract §2: Closing/RecoveryRequired until actual resolution; no release through close intent alone. |
| CHK011 | The plan finalized waiting requests at stop, while the specification described resumption only in general terms | FR-013, Public Contract §1 and Data Model §Restart and Retention delimit stored Cancelled/NotStarted at stop from still Queued after a crash. |
| CHK012 | Independent continued work was formulated without an explicit limit due to occupied uncertain slots | FR-011, Plan §Project Structure and Public Contract §3 name free residual capacity as a prerequisite; no bypassing of reservations. |
| CHK019 | “Locally visible after triggering” did not sufficiently define the start of measurement and the observable state | SC-004 names monotonic measurement, receipt/deadline end, durably queryable final state and certainty; available storage and cooperative controlled requests are prerequisites. |
| CHK020 | The distribution of the three waiting and the running request across the two recovery sessions was missing | SC-009 and Quickstart §5: three Queued in A, Running in B, one completed result each, separate workspaces, limit two. |
| CHK021 | Load/loss definitions were partly open; the 2+3 capacity result depended on the first scheduler run | SC-001/SC-002/SC-003/SC-007 add prerequisites, distribution and the notion of loss. SC-005 starts with two running requests and eight further arrivals, so that three additional acceptances and five rejections are unambiguous. |
| CHK025 | “Bounded waiting” could mean an undefined waiting-time/fairness guarantee | FR-008, Data Model §Restart and Retention and Public Contract §3 define admissible FIFO heads, tie-break and an explicitly absent global waiting/starvation guarantee. |
| CHK034 | “Limit large outputs and mark them as incomplete” left silently truncated success responses open | FR-021, Public Contract §5, Data Model §RequestResult and HistoryEntry and Provider Contract §1: inclusive byte limits; reject oversized inputs; output overrun as an error with empty Output/OutputComplete=false, no change to earlier history. |
| CHK037 | Open governance TODOs had no sufficiently explicit responsibility and decision boundary in the plan | Plan §Constitution Check assigns ratification confirmation and Codemetr approval to the project owner. Actual decisions remain open; Q-01 is not marked as passed. |
| CHK039 | A running dispatch had no unambiguous execution certainty; Interrupted was only indirectly contained in the public state catalog | FR-009, Data Model §Request and Public Contract §7 name the complete state catalog and separate certainty including InProgress as well as permissible combinations. |
| CHK040 | Rejection of new schemas was described, but the scope of actual migrations remained indirect | Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §StoreMetadata, Plan §Project Structure and Provider Contract §2: the first delivery opens only its known format; no automatic migration/downgrade, unchanged rejection of incompatible formats, plan a later format change separately. |

| CHK023–CHK024 | Provider Contract §2–5 as well as FR-004/FR-011/FR-012/FR-025 treat lazy binding, first handover and attributed errors without a substitute provider. |
| CHK026–CHK030 | User Stories 3/5, FR-018–FR-021, Public Contract §3/§4 and Data Model §RecoveryDecision/Restart govern stop, crash, lost confirmation, uncertain effect, decision revision and retention. CHK026 was additionally clarified in the course of CHK011. |
| CHK031–CHK033 | FR-014/FR-015/FR-021/FR-023/FR-026, Constitution §V, Plan §Target Platform and Public Contract §5 define trust boundary, data protection and actual platform acceptance. |
| CHK035–CHK036 | Provider Contract §3/§4 and Spec §Assumptions limit native retention/recoverability; FR-027 delimits consumption and migration. |
| CHK038 | Constitution §IV, Plan §TDD Implementation Strategy and Quickstart §6 explicitly exclude missing credentials as a Red substitute and simulated live approvals. |

  proves no tool or code check.
